lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Hello Commander!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Do you remember me?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: It's me, Regale!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I'm the vice president of a gastronome group called "Good Eats."

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I'm all about sampling new delish foods from around the world.
It's been a while.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: You remember me? What an honor!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: My fellow foodies and I really got a kick out of that food you brought us last time.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: However.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: It tasted TOO good! My colleagues and I have been obsessed with it ever since.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: It's all we ever think about. We can't even get any work done!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: It's awful, I tell you! Just awful!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: So, I was wondering if...
Do you want me to bring you some food from up on the surface again?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Yesyesyes!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We'd be eternally grateful to you if you did.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: But this time, we wanted to try something different.
For example?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We managed to get our hands on some sweet potatoes grown up on the surface.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Apparently, the flavor is out of this world if you roast them over a campfire.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Naturally, you can make an artificial flame in the Ark,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: but it just won't be the same as a true, bona fide campfire made using real wood.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Doesn't that sound amazing?
What's the difference? Fire is fire.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: You couldn't be more wrong!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Every food has its culinary soulmate.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: The sweet potatoes that we acquired are organic.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: So we want natural, organic wood to cook them with.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: That's how it works.
Okay, I'll try it.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Excellent!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Can't wait to hear from you!
